MIND. [1] [Bar. c.]
Great mental and bodily weakness ; childishness. θ Old people.
   

INNER HEAD. [3] [Bar. c.]
Pressure in brain under vertex, towards occiput, on waking, with stiffness of neck.
Apoplexy ; with old people.
   

OUTER HEAD. [4] [Bar. c.]
Crusta lactea, dry scurf ; moist crusts ; itching ; burning ; causes hair to fall out ; cervical glands hard, swollen.
Falling off of hair ; baldness, especially on crown.
   

SIGHT AND EYES. [5] [Bar. c.]
Light dazzles and hurts eyes ; fiery sparks before eyes in dark.
   

HEARING AND EARS. [6] [Bar. c.]
Eruption on and behind ears.
Parotitis after scarlatina.
   

SMELL AND NOSE. [7] [Bar. c.]
Coryza : nose and upper lip swollen ; children with large abdomen.
   

UPPER FACE. [8] [Bar. c.]
Redness of face. θ Quinsy.
   

LOWER FACE. [9] [Bar. c.]
Painful swelling of submaxillary glands, with induration. θ After scarlatina.
   

TASTE, SPEECH, TONGUE. [11] [Bar. c.]
Paralysis of tongue. θ Old people.
Speechless ; tongue paralyzed. θ Apoplexy.
   

INNER MOUTH. [12] [Bar. c.]
Dryness of mouth early after rising.
Salivation ; inability to swallow ; suffocation ; throat suppurating ; fever. θ Angina tonsillaris.
   

PALATE AND THROAT. [13] [Bar. c.]
Inflammation of cellular membranes of fauces and tonsils, with fever ; difficult swallowing and speaking. θ Quinsy.
Inflamed and enlarged tonsils.
Acute tonsillitis.
Liability to tonsillitis ; after every slight cold, or suppressed foot sweat.
Disposition to acute tonsillitis, with suppuration.
Chronic induration of tonsils ; sensation as of a plug in throat ; < after swallowing solids.
Tonsils tend to suppurate, especially right ; palate swollen ; dark brown urine ; sleeplessness.
Smarting in throat when swallowing ; < from empty swallowing ; throat sore to touch.
Inability to swallow anything but liquids. θ Spasmodic stricture of œsophagus.
   

EATING AND DRINKING. [15] [Bar. c.]
Stomach aches also after eating.
   

HICCOUGH, BELCHING, NAUSEA AND VOMITING. [16] [Bar. c.]
Waterbrash.
   

ABDOMEN AND LOINS. [19] [Bar. c.]
Abdomen hard, tense. θ Scrofulous children.
   

STOOLS AND RECTUM. [20] [Bar. c.]
Hemorrhoidal affections.
   

MALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [22] [Bar. c.]
Diminished sexual desire and ability.
Impotence.
Relaxed penis and premature emission.
   

VOICE AND LARYNX. TRACHEA AND BRONCHIA. [25] [Bar. c.]
Feeling in larynx as if inspiring smoke or pitch.
   

RESPIRATION. [26] [Bar. c.]
Suffocative catarrh of old people, with impending paralysis of lungs.
   

COUGH. [27] [Bar. c.]
Night-cough, with asthmatic breathing.
Chronic cough in scrofulous children, with swollen glands and enlarged tonsils ; < after slight cold.
Mucous catarrh.
   

HEART, PULSE AND CIRCULATION. [29] [Bar. c.]
Palpitation ; feels heart beat.
   

NECK AND BACK. [31] [Bar. c.]
Swelling of glands in nape of neck and occiput.
Fatty tumors, especially about neck.
Pain in small of back. θ Diarrhœa.
   

UPPER LIMBS. [32] [Bar. c.]
Pains in arms, with hard, swollen axillary glands.
   

LOWER LIMBS. [33] [Bar. c.]
Sudden sharp pains running through knee force them to sit down, laming knee, after hard work ; most with girls.
Fetid foot sweat.
Foot sweat, toes and soles get sore ; odor offensive ; (after silic.).
Checked foot sweat.
   

SLEEP. [37] [Bar. c.]
Awakens often at night ; feels too hot ; soles feel bruised.
Night sweat.
   

FEVER. [40] [Bar. c.]
Offensive sweat of one (mostly left) side.
   

TISSUES. [44] [Bar. c.]
Incipient suppuration in glands (axillary), and in cellular tissues in any part of body.
Glandular sequela of scarlatina.
Atrophia scrofulosis (next to Calc. ostr.).
Marasmus senilis
Fatty tumors.
Encysted tumors.
Cystic growths, particularly on skull.
   

SKIN. [46] [Bar. c.]
Skin diseases.
Soreness and humid skin.
Warts.
   

STAGE OF LIFE, CONSTITUTION. [47] [Bar. c.]
Suitable for affections of first childhood, but more particularly for old age, with mental or physical weakness.
Is especially suitable for dwarfish women.
Complaints of dwarfish children, those who do not grow.
Scrofulous children ; dwarfish ; mind and body weak ; scurfs on head, ears, nose ; eyes inflamed, opaque cornea ; colic abdomen swollen ; face puffed ; general emaciation.
Persons subject to quinsy ; especially those who suffer from inflammation of throat and swelling of tonsils after the least cold.
(bar. a) Old cachectic people of scrofulous habit, especially when they suffer with gouty complaints.
Old people, especially when fat.
